key_insight: MS-Exam-Gen is a reproducible, source-grounded workflow for building and auditing a text-only multiple-choice benchmark to test LLM knowledge of multiple sclerosis MRI concepts.
clinical_relevance: It helps researchers evaluate whether biomedical LLMs can answer current MS-MRI criteria, protocols, reporting, and differential-diagnosis questions with auditable, source-based accuracy.
method: Indexed 66 expert sources into 4,289 retrieval chunks
Generated and filtered a locked 3,058-item candidate benchmark across 16 topics and 53 subtopics
Ran automated quality audits, same-family consistency screening, and empirical calibration
evidence_signal: Across 12 LLM endpoints, the benchmark produced 36,696 item-level predictions and showed a wide accuracy spread from 89.7% to 46.9%, with 25.5% of items missed by at least four models.
watch_item: This is not a clinically certified exam; construction labels are metadata, and expert adjudication plus full option-order counterbalancing were not completed.
paper_title: MS-Exam-Gen: Source-Grounded Benchmark Construction for Evaluating LLMs on Textual Multiple Sclerosis MRI Knowledge
